newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent edges higher, trade quiet, charts weak.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent edges higher, trade quiet, charts weak.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures were slightly firmer in a quiet start to the week, traders said.
August Brent stood five cents a barrel firmer at 0951 GMT and was trading at $18.11, while July gas oil was $1 up at $163.00.
"There is nothing new really," one IPE broker said. "There is a bit of stability coming back into the front (August/September) spread - we were up at 16 cents and we are back down to 11 or 12 now."
Technical analysts said the chart patterns on Brent and gas oil pointed to further losses.
Support for Brent would be found first at the psychologically important $18.00 level, then at $17.65, $17.48 and at the front month continuation chart's latest low at $17.32.
Gas oil would find support at $158.00 a tonne, they added.
Dealers said they expected increases in activity after the open of U.S. markets, which were closed on Friday because of the Independence Day holiday.
